description.en: Given an array of N integers and a number K, find the Kth largest element in the array.
description.hi: N integers ka array aur ek number K diya hai, array mein Kth sabse bada element dhundho.

hints.en: Use a Min Heap of size K. The top of the heap will be the Kth largest.
hints.hi: Size K ka Min Heap use karo. Heap ka top Kth largest hoga.

hints.en: Push elements into heap. If size exceeds K, pop the minimum.
hints.hi: Elements ko heap mein push karo. Agar size K se zyada ho jaye to minimum pop karo.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
k = int(input())
# Find and print Kth largest element

approach.en: Use a Min Heap of size K. Iterate through the array, push each element. If heap size exceeds K, pop the minimum. After processing all elements, the top of the heap is the Kth largest.
approach.hi: Size K ka Min Heap use karo. Array mein iterate karo, har element push karo. Agar heap size K se zyada ho jaye to minimum pop karo. Saare elements process karne ke baad, heap ka top Kth largest hai.

code.python:
import heapq
min_heap = []
for x in arr:
    heapq.heappush(min_heap, x)
    if len(min_heap) > k:
        heapq.heappop(min_heap)
print(min_heap[0])

description.en: Given an array of N integers, sort the array in ascending order using Heap Sort algorithm.
description.hi: N integers ka array diya hai, Heap Sort algorithm use karke array ko ascending order mein sort karo.

explanation.en: Build max heap, then extract max repeatedly to get sorted array.
explanation.hi: Max heap banao, phir baar baar max extract karke sorted array paao.

explanation.en: Reverse sorted input gets sorted correctly.
explanation.hi: Ulta sorted input sahi se sort ho jaata hai.

hints.en: Build a Max Heap from the array in O(n) time.
hints.hi: Array se Max Heap banao O(n) time mein.

hints.en: Swap root with last element, reduce heap size, heapify down from root.
hints.hi: Root ko last element se swap karo, heap size kam karo, root se heapify down karo.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Heap sort and print sorted array

approach.en: Build a Max Heap in O(n) by calling heapify from last non-leaf node to root. Then repeatedly swap root (max) with last unsorted element and heapify down.
approach.hi: Last non-leaf node se root tak heapify call karke O(n) mein Max Heap banao. Phir baar baar root (max) ko last unsorted element se swap karo aur heapify down karo.

problems.title: Merge K Sorted Arrays
problems.titleHi: K Sorted Arrays ko Merge Karo

description.en: Given K sorted arrays of size N each, merge them into a single sorted array.
description.hi: K sorted arrays diye hain jinka size N hai, unhe ek single sorted array mein merge karo.

explanation.en: All three sorted arrays merged into one sorted array.
explanation.hi: Teeno sorted arrays ko ek sorted array mein merge kar diya.

hints.en: Use a Min Heap of size K. Push first element from each array with array index and element index.
hints.hi: Size K ka Min Heap use karo. Har array ka pehla element array index aur element index ke saath push karo.

hints.en: Pop minimum from heap, add to result, push next element from same array.
hints.hi: Heap se minimum pop karo, result mein add karo, same array se next element push karo.

starterCode.python:
k, n = map(int, input().split())
arr = []
for _ in range(k):
    arr.append(list(map(int, input().split())))
# Merge and print sorted result

approach.en: Use a Min Heap storing (value, array_index, element_index). Push first element of each array. Pop min, add to result, push next element from same array if available.
approach.hi: Min Heap use karo jisme (value, array_index, element_index) store ho. Har array ka pehla element push karo. Min pop karo, result mein daalo, same array se next element push karo agar available hai.

code.python:
import heapq
pq = []
for i in range(k):
    heapq.heappush(pq, (arr[i][0], i, 0))
res = []
while pq:
    val, ai, ei = heapq.heappop(pq)
    res.append(val)
    if ei + 1 < n:
        heapq.heappush(pq, (arr[ai][ei+1], ai, ei+1))
print(*res)

description.en: Given a stream of integers, find the median after each element is added. The median is the middle value in a sorted list. If the list has even size, the median is the average of the two middle values (print floor value).
description.hi: Integers ka stream diya hai, har element add hone ke baad median dhundho. Median sorted list ki beech wali value hai. Agar list ka size even hai to median do beech wali values ka average hai (floor value print karo).

explanation.en: After 5: median=5. After 15: median=(5+15)/2=10. After 1: sorted=[1,5,15], median=5. After 3: sorted=[1,3,5,15], median=(3+5)/2=4. After 8: sorted=[1,3,5,8,15], median=5.
explanation.hi: 5 ke baad: median=5. 15 ke baad: median=(5+15)/2=10. 1 ke baad: sorted=[1,5,15], median=5. 3 ke baad: sorted=[1,3,5,15], median=(3+5)/2=4. 8 ke baad: sorted=[1,3,5,8,15], median=5.

hints.en: Use two heaps: a Max Heap for the left half and a Min Heap for the right half.
hints.hi: Do heaps use karo: left half ke liye Max Heap aur right half ke liye Min Heap.

hints.en: Balance the heaps so that their sizes differ by at most 1.
hints.hi: Heaps ko balance karo taaki unke sizes mein zyada se zyada 1 ka difference ho.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# For each element, print running median

approach.en: Maintain two heaps: maxHeap (left half) and minHeap (right half). For each new number, add to maxHeap if <= maxHeap top, else add to minHeap. Balance so sizes differ by at most 1. Median is top of larger heap, or floor of average of both tops if equal size.
approach.hi: Do heaps maintain karo: maxHeap (left half) aur minHeap (right half). Har naye number ke liye, agar maxHeap top se chhota ya barabar hai to maxHeap mein daalo, nahi to minHeap mein. Balance karo taaki sizes mein max 1 ka difference ho. Median bade heap ka top hai, ya agar dono equal size hain to dono tops ka floor average.

description.en: Given an array of N integers and a number K, return the K most frequent elements. Output them in any order.
description.hi: N integers ka array aur ek number K diya hai, K sabse zyada baar aane wale elements return karo. Kisi bhi order mein output do.

explanation.en: 1 appears 3 times, 2 appears 2 times. Top 2 frequent are 1 and 2.
explanation.hi: 1 teen baar aata hai, 2 do baar aata hai. Top 2 frequent 1 aur 2 hain.

hints.en: Count frequency using a hash map, then use a Min Heap of size K on frequencies.
hints.hi: Hash map se frequency count karo, phir frequencies pe size K ka Min Heap use karo.

hints.en: The Min Heap keeps the K elements with highest frequency.
hints.hi: Min Heap K sabse zyada frequency wale elements rakhega.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
k = int(input())
# Find and print K most frequent elements

approach.en: Count frequencies with a hash map. Use a Min Heap of size K storing (frequency, element). For each entry, push to heap. If size > K, pop minimum. Remaining K elements are the answer.
approach.hi: Hash map se frequencies count karo. Size K ka Min Heap use karo jisme (frequency, element) store ho. Har entry ke liye heap mein push karo. Agar size K se zyada ho to minimum pop karo. Bache hue K elements answer hain.

code.python:
from collections import Counter
import heapq
freq = Counter(arr)
heap = []
for val, cnt in freq.items():
    heapq.heappush(heap, (cnt, val))
    if len(heap) > k:
        heapq.heappop(heap)
res = sorted([x[1] for x in heap])
print(*res)

problems.title: Kth Smallest in Sorted Matrix
problems.titleHi: Sorted Matrix mein Kth Sabse Chhota

description.en: Given an N x N matrix where each row and each column is sorted in ascending order, find the Kth smallest element in the matrix.
description.hi: N x N matrix diya hai jisme har row aur har column ascending order mein sorted hai, matrix mein Kth sabse chhota element dhundho.

hints.en: Use a Min Heap. Push first element of each row. Pop K times.
hints.hi: Min Heap use karo. Har row ka pehla element push karo. K baar pop karo.

hints.en: Each time you pop, push the next element from the same row.
hints.hi: Har baar pop karne pe, same row se next element push karo.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
mat = []
for _ in range(n):
    mat.append(list(map(int, input().split())))
k = int(input())
# Find and print Kth smallest element

approach.en: Use Min Heap with entries (value, row, col). Push first element of each row. Pop minimum K times. Each time, push the next element from the same row if it exists.
approach.hi: Min Heap use karo jisme (value, row, col) entries hon. Har row ka pehla element push karo. K baar minimum pop karo. Har baar same row se next element push karo agar exist karta hai.

code.python:
import heapq
pq = [(mat[i][0], i, 0) for i in range(n)]
heapq.heapify(pq)
ans = 0
for _ in range(k):
    ans, r, c = heapq.heappop(pq)
    if c + 1 < n:
        heapq.heappush(pq, (mat[r][c+1], r, c+1))
print(ans)

problems.title: Connect N Ropes with Minimum Cost
problems.titleHi: N Rassiyon ko Minimum Cost mein Jodo

description.en: Given N ropes of different lengths, connect all ropes into one rope. The cost to connect two ropes is the sum of their lengths. Find the minimum total cost to connect all ropes.
description.hi: N alag-alag lambaai ki rassiyaan di hain, sabhi rassiyon ko ek rassi mein jodo. Do rassiyon ko jodne ki cost unki lambaiyon ka sum hai. Sabhi rassiyon ko jodne ki minimum total cost dhundho.

hints.en: Always connect the two shortest ropes first to minimize cost.
hints.hi: Hamesha sabse chhoti do rassiyaan pehle jodo taaki cost minimum ho.

hints.en: Use a Min Heap to always get the two smallest ropes efficiently.
hints.hi: Min Heap use karo taaki efficiently do sabse chhoti rassiyaan mil sakein.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
ropes = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Find and print minimum cost

approach.en: Use a Min Heap. Push all rope lengths. While heap has more than 1 element: pop two smallest, add their sum to total cost, push their sum back. This greedy approach minimizes cost.
approach.hi: Min Heap use karo. Sabhi rope lengths push karo. Jab tak heap mein 1 se zyada elements hain: do sabse chhote pop karo, unka sum total cost mein add karo, unka sum wapas push karo. Ye greedy approach cost minimize karti hai.

code.python:
import heapq
heapq.heapify(ropes)
cost = 0
while len(ropes) > 1:
    a = heapq.heappop(ropes)
    b = heapq.heappop(ropes)
    cost += a + b
    heapq.heappush(ropes, a + b)
print(cost)

description.en: You have a collection of stones with positive integer weights. Each turn, pick the two heaviest stones and smash them. If they have equal weight, both are destroyed. If not, the stone with smaller weight is destroyed, and the other stone's weight is reduced by the smaller weight. Return the weight of the last remaining stone, or 0 if none remain.
description.hi: Tumhare paas positive integer weights wale pattharon ka collection hai. Har turn mein, do sabse bhaari patthar uthao aur takrao. Agar dono ka weight barabar hai to dono destroy ho jaate hain. Agar nahi to chhote weight wala destroy ho jaata hai aur doosre ka weight chhote weight se kam ho jaata hai. Aakhri bache hue patthar ka weight return karo, ya 0 agar koi nahi bacha.

explanation.en: Smash 8,7->1, smash 4,2->2, smash 2,1->1, smash 1,1->0. Last stone: 1.
explanation.hi: 8,7 takrao->1, 4,2 takrao->2, 2,1 takrao->1, 1,1 takrao->0. Aakhri patthar: 1.

hints.en: Use a Max Heap. Pop two largest, push their difference if non-zero.
hints.hi: Max Heap use karo. Do sabse bade pop karo, unka difference push karo agar non-zero hai.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
stones = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Find and print last stone weight

approach.en: Use a Max Heap. Push all stones. While heap has more than 1 element: pop two largest. If they differ, push the difference back. Return last element or 0.
approach.hi: Max Heap use karo. Saare patthar push karo. Jab tak heap mein 1 se zyada elements hain: do sabse bade pop karo. Agar different hain to difference wapas push karo. Last element return karo ya 0.

code.python:
import heapq
max_h = [-s for s in stones]
heapq.heapify(max_h)
while len(max_h) > 1:
    a = -heapq.heappop(max_h)
    b = -heapq.heappop(max_h)
    if a != b:
        heapq.heappush(max_h, -(a - b))
print(-max_h[0] if max_h else 0)

problems.title: K Closest Points to Origin
problems.titleHi: Origin ke K Sabse Nazdeeki Points

description.en: Given an array of points where points[i] = [xi, yi] represents a point on the 2D plane, return the K closest points to the origin (0, 0). The distance is Euclidean distance. Print points sorted by distance.
description.hi: Points ka array diya hai jahan points[i] = [xi, yi] 2D plane pe ek point hai, origin (0, 0) ke K sabse nazdeeki points return karo. Distance Euclidean distance hai. Points ko distance ke hisaab se sort karke print karo.

hints.en: Use a Max Heap of size K based on distance. No need to compute sqrt - compare squared distances.
hints.hi: Distance ke basis pe size K ka Max Heap use karo. Sqrt calculate karne ki zaroorat nahi - squared distances compare karo.

hints.en: Push points into heap. If size > K, pop the farthest point.
hints.hi: Points ko heap mein push karo. Agar size K se zyada ho to sabse door wala point pop karo.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
points = []
for _ in range(n):
    x, y = map(int, input().split())
    points.append((x, y))
k = int(input())
# Find and print K closest points

approach.en: Use a Max Heap of size K storing (-distance^2, x, y). For each point, push to heap. If size > K, pop the farthest. Finally, sort remaining points by distance and print.
approach.hi: Size K ka Max Heap use karo jisme (-distance^2, x, y) store ho. Har point ke liye heap mein push karo. Agar size K se zyada ho to sabse door wala pop karo. Aakhir mein bache hue points ko distance se sort karke print karo.

problems.title: Reorganize String

description.en: Given a string S, rearrange the characters so that no two adjacent characters are the same. If not possible, return "impossible". If multiple valid answers exist, return any.
description.hi: Ek string S diya hai, characters ko aisa arrange karo ki koi do adjacent characters same na hon. Agar possible nahi hai to "impossible" return karo. Agar multiple valid answers hain to koi bhi return karo.

explanation.en: Rearranged so no two adjacent characters are same.
explanation.hi: Aisa arrange kiya ki koi do adjacent characters same nahi hain.

explanation.en: Not possible to rearrange - 'a' appears too many times.
explanation.hi: Rearrange possible nahi - 'a' bahut zyada baar aata hai.

constraints: S consists of lowercase English letters

hints.en: Use a Max Heap based on character frequency. Always place the most frequent character first.
hints.hi: Character frequency ke basis pe Max Heap use karo. Hamesha sabse zyada frequency wala character pehle lagao.

hints.en: After placing a character, push the previously placed character back (if frequency > 0) to avoid adjacency.
hints.hi: Ek character lagane ke baad, pehle wale character ko wapas push karo (agar frequency > 0 hai) taaki adjacency avoid ho.

starterCode.python:
s = input()
# Reorganize and print result
starterCode.javascript:
const s = require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8').trim();
// Reorganize and print result

approach.en: Count frequencies. Use Max Heap of (freq, char). Pop most frequent, append to result. Hold the previous character aside. Push previous back if its frequency > 0. If heap is empty but previous still has frequency, return impossible.
approach.hi: Frequencies count karo. Max Heap use karo (freq, char) ka. Sabse zyada frequent pop karo, result mein append karo. Previous character ko side mein rakho. Previous ko wapas push karo agar frequency > 0 hai. Agar heap khaali hai lekin previous ki frequency abhi bhi hai to impossible return karo.

code.python:
from collections import Counter
import heapq
freq = Counter(s)
max_h = [(-cnt, ch) for ch, cnt in freq.items()]
heapq.heapify(max_h)
res = []
prev = (0, '#')
while max_h:
    cnt, ch = heapq.heappop(max_h)
    res.append(ch)
    if prev[0] < 0:
        heapq.heappush(max_h, prev)
    prev = (cnt + 1, ch)
result = ''.join(res)
print(result if len(result) == len(s) else 'impossible')
